summary: After an in-session record_delivery exit the capturing session is the pinned executing actor, so CD-0013 D5 refuses its verdict and no distinct evaluator exists. record_verdict then accepts the operator's signed identity (the confirm_premise mechanism), stamped as the verdict actor, strictly conditioned on a record_delivery completion; lane-executed exits keep CD-0109's distinct-actor rule, and the agent surface mints the operator challenge exactly for the lease-holding session.
title: the operator signs the verdict after an in-session delivery
